livent_2018_10k.identity_observation: The PDF identifies Livent Corporation, Form 10-K, fiscal year ended 2018-12-31 and the same SEC filing accession family.
livent_2018_10k.target_claim_observation: The filing states that automotive OEMs were moving toward high-nickel cathode materials and that this shift would increasingly require battery-grade lithium hydroxide in cathode production.

livent_2019q1_10q.target_claim_observation: The contemporaneous filing states that the transition to higher-nickel cathode chemistries was progressing more slowly than anticipated, delaying lithium-hydroxide sales, with some customers using lower-cost carbonate or lower-performance hydroxide.
